method.measurements: wall-clock queue/readback/native-window wait times, process CPU time; not GPU timestamps or displayed FPS
method.summary: Median of three trial means; each trial equally averages its two maps at the same pixel size. P95 entries are means of scene P95s, not pooled percentiles.
method.metal: Native drawable backpressure remains despite requested vsync=0. Native palette rendering changes for both OpenGL and Metal; compare each backend separately.

incompleteTrials.reason: Own-window screencapture tool timed out after 15 seconds during resized proof. Incomplete artifacts preserved; whole case repeated, earlier complete cases retained.

isolation.source: Exported engine base plus TileRenderer and the palette frame-cache module; identical current performance driver for measured stages.
isolation.assets: Only imported game-version assets from previous task-owned fresh imports; no saves/options copied.

limits: no GPU timestamps or displayed FPS acceptance
no claim about all gameplay/fullscreen/context loss/platforms
existing protected runtime not altered; external load not controlled

fireredHighResolutionFollowup.reason: Primary high-resolution OpenGL control had +26.1% CPU/+21.3% mean render wall time; followup declared before running.
fireredHighResolutionFollowup.conclusion: Large primary slowdown did not reproduce consistently. CPU medians are slightly higher while render wall median is lower; trial variation exceeds these differences. A small performance regression cannot be excluded on this non-dedicated host. Static colour cache usage stayed zero.

pixelRegression.readbackOracle: Independent ROM-word palette colours, native atlas/animation variants, all reflection-cover quads, live visible floor cell; retained GPU identity/map return; FireRed native 16-frame animation/indoor movement

regression.nativePixelLifetimeSuite: passed: independent layer/animation/cover pixels, unchanged GPU resources/borders, warm cycles, failed uploads, metadata/source/asset invalidation
